name: Depthless Cell Face Projection
definition: A projection-based direct volume rendering method for curvilinear grids where each data value is mapped to color and opacity, and cell faces are drawn as Gouraud-shaded polygons. Depth is not considered during compositing.
summary: Depthless Cell Face Projection is a fast direct volume rendering method for curvilinear grids that projects cell faces as shaded polygons without depth sorting, prioritizing speed over physical accuracy.
